summary: Ran backend + frontend regression for new Expenses Analysis module on public preview URL. API seed/list/cleanup flows passed and UI reached analysis page with correct monthly cards/table for seeded dataset; full print/yearly runtime recheck was partially blocked by Playwright Arabic-number parsing assertions.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (401x5 then valid login returns 200).
No app-issued HttpOnly auth session cookie observed; login still token-in-body flow (only Cloudflare cookie present).
access-control-allow-origin is '*' instead of explicit allowlist origin posture for credentialed auth hardening.
Existing admin is returned early and not updated when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (seed admin not idempotent).

integration_issues.issue: Runtime validation for yearly/scope/print in this iteration is partial because Playwright assertions failed on Arabic numeral parsing in the test script after page data loaded correctly.

action_items: Re-run one clean Playwright pass for yearly/scope/print assertions with robust Arabic numeral normalization in the test script.
If security policy requires cookie sessions, add app-issued HttpOnly auth cookie flow.
Replace wildcard CORS with explicit allowed origins aligned to credentialed auth policy.
Make admin seeding idempotent by reconciling existing admin password hash when env password changes.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpensesAnalysisPage classification and aggregation logic is frontend-only over /api/expenses (no dedicated backend reporting endpoint), so large datasets may shift computation burden to client.
bcrypt hashing path uses bcrypt.hashpw(...bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)) which is compatible with expected $2b$ hash format.
backend/server.py remains a large monolith, increasing maintenance and regression risk.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST ITER19 expense rows (7 records, year 2031/month 04) for UI/API validation and removed them with cleanup test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI run confirmed module card, page load, filters-only layout, monthly seeded rows and visible totals/table content on /expenses-analysis. Automation aborted before completing yearly/scope/print assertions due Arabic numeral parsing mismatch in test script; app screenshot shows expected monthly values. Test seed data has been cleaned.
rca of the issue: Auth RCA: login handler validates credentials directly without failed-attempt state/lockout branch; CORS middleware responds with wildcard allow-origin; response does not set app auth cookie. Seed admin RCA: ensure_default_admin exits when any admin exists, so env password changes do not reconcile existing admin record.
